about_the_game:
In Tiny Company, you are the owner of a cozy little shop that specializes in creating custom terrariums. But unlike most stores, your clients are not people — they’re the actual future inhabitants of the terrariums! From ants and beetles to snakes, geckos, mantises, snails, and more, each visitor arrives with a specific vision for their terrarium dream home, and it’s your job to bring it to life.

In the full release version of the game, there are 3 different game modes you can choose from and have lots of fun:

• STORY Mode
Each client comes in person to your shop, greets you with a short dialogue, and provides a reference photo of the terrarium they’d like you to build. You must recreate their desired terrarium layout using the decorative elements available in your shop. Try to match the reference as closely as possible to get the highest score, trigger unique dialogue reactions, or unlock the next level.

• DAILY Mode
In this mode, you’ll receive orders online as daily challenges. Complete them to maintain your track record and hold your place or advance on the leaderboard.

• ENDLESS Mode
Here, you’ll keep receiving online orders and can complete as many as you like. Have fun, get creative, and design countless unique terrariums. This mode also features a scoring system to help you compete for a top spot on the leaderboard.

• THE CONTROLS
Using your mouse, click on boxes, sacks, or piles of sticks to drop items onto the counter. Then, pick up each item, hover it over the terrarium to position it, and let it drop inside.
But there’s a catch: once you place an object, you can’t move it again. Also, items may have different properties, making interactions more fun and slightly more challenging.

In Story Mode, after completing a terrarium, your design is evaluated for accuracy and creativity, with a final score between 0 and 3 stars. Depending on how well you’ve captured the client’s vision, their reactions will vary, sometimes sweet, sometimes disappointed.
As you earn stars, you’ll unlock new levels with different creatures, each presenting fresh decorative challenges. You can always revisit previous levels to aim for a better score.

In Daily and Endless modes, the gameplay remains the same, but the scoring system is different: you earn points that let you compete against other players for a place on the leaderboard.

Join our official Discord server to connect with other players, suggest new ideas, report bugs, or just chat with a great group of people.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Processor: Any dual-core processor (Intel i3 or equivalent)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD 4000 or equivalent)
  • Storage: 100 MB MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, macOS 10.13, or later
  • Processor: Intel i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (NVIDIA GTX 660 or equivalent) for smoother performance
  • Storage: 100 MB available space

short_description: In Tiny Company you run a cozy little shop where you design custom terrariums for tiny clients.Have a chat with quirky critters, learn their personalities, follow their oddly instructions, and design the home of their dreams.
